extensionDescription.message: Access bookmarks instantly from a keyboard-driven command palette using nicknames. Designed for keyboard-focused power users.

errorMultipleUrlsFound.message: Multiple URLs found. Please select a candidate from the suggestions.

errorUrlExists.message: This URL already exists for this nickname.

errorInvalidJsonStructure.message: Invalid JSON structure. Missing 'bookmarks' root key.

syncDescription.message: Sync your bookmarks across devices using your Google account (Limit: 100KB).

confirmEnableSyncWithData.message: Existing cloud data found. Which data do you want to use?

confirmDisableSyncWithData.message: Local data already exists. Which data do you want to keep?

errorSyncQuotaExceeded.message: Local data exceeds 100KB. Please reduce data before enabling sync.

syncDisabledMessage.message: Sync has been disabled. Data copied to local.

syncDisabledMessageOnly.message: Sync has been disabled. Local data kept.

defaultValueLabel.message: Default value when query is omitted (Optional)

defaultValuePlaceholder.message: Default value for %s (navigates to site's top page if left blank)

bookmarkAlreadyExistsMessage.message: This URL is already registered under nickname '$1'.

errorUserScriptsNotAllowed.message: To run bookmarklets, please enable 'Allow User Scripts' in the extension details (chrome://extensions).

errorBookmarkletRestrictedPage.message: Bookmarklets cannot be executed on this page (browser internal pages, web store, etc.).

popupNoMatches.message: No matching bookmarks or commands found.

popupAddEnterPrompt.message: Enter a nickname and press Enter to register (e.g. :add gh)

popupCommandAddallHint.message: Register all tabs in current window

popupNoOpenableTabUrl.message: Could not retrieve a valid URL from the current tab.

openAllInFolder.message: 📁 Open all bookmarks in folder '$1' ($2 tabs)

confirmDeleteFolderMessage.message: Are you sure you want to delete all bookmarks ($2 items) in folder '$1'? This action cannot be undone.

deleteFolderSuccessMessage.message: Deleted folder '$1' and all its bookmarks.

maxBatchOpenTabsLabel.message: Safety limit for batch open tabs

maxBatchOpenTabsDescription.message: The maximum number of tabs to open automatically when batch opening a folder (1-100, default: 20). If this limit is exceeded, a confirmation prompt will be displayed.

confirmBatchOpenMessage.message: Folder '$1' contains $2 tabs, which exceeds the safety limit ($3 tabs). Do you want to open all of them?

errorBatchOpenZeroUrls.message: No openable URLs found in folder '$1' (bookmarklets only or empty).

historySearchLabel.message: Include Browser History in Popup Search

historySearchDescription.message: When enabled, matching browser history entries are shown below bookmark suggestions in the popup (requires permission to access browsing history).

historySearchEnabledMessage.message: Browser history search has been enabled.

historySearchDisabledMessage.message: Browser history search has been disabled.

historyPermissionDeniedMessage.message: Could not enable because permission to access browser history was denied.

popupTipAddCommand.message: Use :add <name> (or :a) to bookmark the current tab immediately.

popupTipAddallCommand.message: Use :addall <name> (or :aa) to bookmark all tabs in the current window at once.

popupTipFolderOpen.message: Type folder/ and press Enter to open all bookmarks in that folder at once.

popupTipDynamicUrl.message: Include %s in a URL to pass search terms via 'nickname query' (falls back to default value or homepage when omitted).

popupTipTabDisposition.message: Press Shift+Enter to open in a background tab while keeping the popup open, or $1+Enter to open in a new foreground tab.

popupTipKeyboardNav.message: Navigate suggestions with ↑/↓ or Ctrl+N/Ctrl+P, and press Tab to autocomplete the selected nickname or command.

popupTipBookmarklet.message: Register bookmarklets with :add <name> javascript:... and run them directly on the active tab from search.

popupTipManagementCommands.message: Run :ls to manage bookmarks and folders, :prefs for settings and sync, or :help to open the documentation.

importBaseFolderPlaceholder.message: e.g. imported (keep original hierarchy if empty)

importOverwriteWarning.message: Overwriting will replace all $1 existing bookmark(s) with the imported data.

errorImportNoValidBookmarks.message: No valid bookmarks found to import.

errorImportInvalidHtml.message: Could not parse as a valid bookmark HTML file.

presetsDescription.message: Easily enable popular search services (%s dynamic URLs) and handy bookmarklets via checkboxes. Only your checkbox selections are stored, consuming virtually zero storage space.

presetDescMdlink.message: Copy the current page's [Title](URL) to the clipboard

presetDescHtmllink.message: Copy the current page's Title to the clipboard (multi-MIME for Teams, etc.)

presetDescWayback.message: Open the current page URL in https://web.archive.org/web/*/

popupTipPresets.message: Enable built-in presets like Google Search (g) or GitHub Search (gh) with a single checkbox in Preferences (:prefs).

openInNewTabLabel.message: Open in a new tab by default

openInNewTabDescription.message: When enabled, opening a bookmark or browser history item from the popup without modifier keys opens it in a new foreground tab (Shift+Enter still opens in a background tab).

openInCurrentIfNewTabLabel.message: Open in the current tab when on a New Tab

openInCurrentIfNewTabDescription.message: When enabled, if the active tab is a New Tab page, opening a bookmark or history item without modifier keys opens it in that tab (Cmd/Ctrl/Alt+Enter still opens in a new tab).

errorMdlinkCopyFailed.message: Failed to copy to the clipboard.
